To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

gambling games can be addictive, that this addiction is mediated through the same brain circuits as drug addictions, and that the neural mechanisms of this addiction can be studied using the brain imaging techniques of functional neuroimaging.
gambling disorder is a behavioral addiction with a strong genetic predisposition that involves a neurobiological vulnerability in the reward circuit.
the brain circuitry that underlies the processing of gambling games is dysfunctional in gambling disorder, and this dysfunction is associated with the clinical symptoms of the disease.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the neural mechanisms underlying gambling-related decision making.
understanding the neural basis of gambling-related decision making and how these processes are altered by gambling disorder.
understanding the brain basis of gambling addiction and its translation into clinical disorder.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is no evidence for a specific “addictive brain” in problem gambling.

the brain of the pathological gambler is not the same as that of a normal individual, and that these differences are reflected in a number of different ways, both in the brain and in the behaviour of the pathological gamblers.
gambling is a game of chance and skill.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
gambling disorder is a neurobiological disorder that involves a complex set of brain systems that are influenced by gambling environments.
the brain is the most important organ in our body and it controls all the functions of the body.
we have found evidence that gambling games have a strong influence on the neural circuitry of reward and decision making, which is consistent with a brain disorder account.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the brain’s response to gambling games is not a unitary phenomenon.
gambling games are designed to be engaging, to keep players playing, and to keep them playing for longer.
